authorisation_source: MIW POST-RELEASE PATCH instruction of 10 September 2026 (BULK JUPITER CHEAT-SHEET GOVERNANCE + DEPLOY), section 0: one bounded post-release patch correcting the Bulk Jupiter cheat-sheet propagation omission and giving it governance appropriate to a non-q-card artefact. Section 2 expressly forbids new casualty research, and none was done: the replacement wording carries the adjudicated finding of CORR-REL-BJ-ATTRIBUTION-20260908 and CORR-REL-BJ-FOUNDERING-20260908 and reads no new source. Section 7 requires this to be recorded as POST-RELEASE SAME-PROPOSITION PROPAGATION rather than as a new factual discovery, and section 3 forbids expressing it as a q-card.
title: QB2_B_CheatSheet Key Numbers stated the Bulk Jupiter loss as settled bauxite liquefaction, on the one surface that has no q-card and so could not be owned by any correction record.
candidate_claim: Not a candidate report. Raised by the post-release audit of 9 September 2026, which read the two September 8 records' own propagation claims against the pages they name.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD. Both parent records assert, in `propagation.corpus_agreement_checked`, that 'QB8_H#q5, QB2_B_CheatSheet and the QP2304 / QP2509 past-paper layer carry no cause-strength claim that contradicts the report'. For the cheat sheet that was false when written. Its Key Numbers block read 'MV Bulk Jupiter (2015) - bauxite liquefaction sinking', which is the settled-cause proposition those records removed from three q-cards, on the most memorisation-weighted surface in the corpus. A cheat sheet is what a candidate reads on the morning of the oral, so a settled-cause claim here outranks the qualified wording on the long cards it summarises.
authority: NO NEW SOURCE WAS READ. The governing authority is that of the two parent records, carried across unchanged: Bahamas Maritime Authority, 'M.v Bulk Jupiter - Marine Safety Investigation Report', 18 August 2015, section 5.1 - 'there is no physical evidence to confirm what caused the vessel to adopt an unrecoverable list to starboard and subsequent capsize', concluding only that it is 'most probable that either liquefaction or a free surface effect induced an unrecoverable list'. This record adds no finding of its own and adjudicates nothing; it moves an already-adjudicated proposition onto a surface the parents missed.

propagation.same_defect_swept: The whole class, not this one line. `no_page_asserts_the_cause_as_settled` was documented as closed-world over the deployed bank and was closed-world over the PAGES - it reads every QB*.html - but it matched two literal strings lifted from QB10_B's own prior wording, so it was closed-world over exactly one phrasing. The cheat sheet said the same thing in different words and walked past it. The guard is now a set of five assertion shapes rather than two literals, and a new self-test drives each shape against a specimen of the wording it exists to reject, including the exact pre-edit cheat-sheet line. Re-run closed-world over every QB*.html: no remaining site states the cause as settled.
propagation.same_family_prior: CORR-REL-BJ-ATTRIBUTION-20260908 and CORR-REL-BJ-FOUNDERING-20260908, both 2026-09-08, both carrying known trap 131. This record is their propagated sibling and opens no new class.
propagation.corpus_agreement_checked: The five Bulk Jupiter sites the parents corrected or cleared were re-read. QB8_A#q4, QB5_A#q11 and both QB10_B#q1 sites carry the qualified wording and are byte-identical here. QB8_H#q5 names the casualty and states no cause, as the parents recorded. The cheat sheet is the one site whose clearance was wrong, and it is corrected here.
propagation.not_swept_reported: The past-paper layer (QP2304, QP2501, QP2509) characterises the mechanism as DYNAMIC SEPARATION and says expressly that it is not a simple liquefaction case, while the QB layer says liquefaction. That divergence was REPORTED and not closed by the parent records, and it is not closed here either - this patch is bounded to the cheat sheet and changes no past paper.
propagation.derived_surfaces: None move. QB2_B_CheatSheet carries no q-card block at all - the balanced-div extractor returns zero cards for it - so no anchor, no card identity and no q-text moved. Corpus stays 761 / 86. The content index DOES carry this file, and the first draft of this record wrongly said it did not: meoclass1/qb_content_index.json holds files['QB2_B.html'].cheatsheet = 'QB2_B_CheatSheet.html'. It records the FILENAME and indexes no content from the sheet, so an edit to the sheet's body cannot move it, and a regeneration is a no-op. No examiner, topic, search or index surface moves.
propagation.hub_date: NOT ADVANCED. It stands at 9 Sep 2026, where the release commit 94ae274 set it. The established post-release correction workflow advances the hub date for a new EDITION, not for a correction patch, and the instruction authorising this patch directs the same by default. Recorded explicitly because the parent records say '2 Sep 2026' - true at THEIR baseline and stale at this one, which is how an inherited claim survives into a record that never re-read it.

invariants: One exact-string replacement on one line. The TML/FMP rule, the 35-degree angle-of-repose marker, the Group A moisture rule above it and the wash-down Trap below it are byte-identical.
No q-card exists on this page, so no anchor, no card identity and no derived surface moves. Corpus stays 761 / 86.
No other card, cheat sheet, notes page or past paper was edited by this record.
The casualty is still named on the cheat sheet, and the mechanism is still taught - only the certainty changed, exactly as in the parent records.
No new source was read and no new finding was made. The wording carries the parents' adjudicated finding.

governed_artefacts.proposition: The cause of the loss of MV Bulk Jupiter (2015) is not settled. The flag State found no physical evidence of cause and concluded only that liquefaction OR a free-surface effect is most probable.
governed_artefacts.propagation_reason: POST-RELEASE SAME-PROPOSITION PROPAGATION. The parent record removed this proposition's settled form from QB8_A#q4 and QB10_B#q1 and cleared this page in the same breath. The clearance was wrong: the page stated the settled form in different words. No new finding is made here.
governed_artefacts.expected_text_after: • Casualties: MV Bulk Jupiter (2015) — bauxite; most probably liquefaction or a free-surface effect (flag State found no physical evidence of cause)

supersedes_summary: Corrects one claim in two shipped records without editing either. CORR-REL-BJ-ATTRIBUTION-20260908 and CORR-REL-BJ-FOUNDERING-20260908 both assert in `propagation.corpus_agreement_checked` that QB2_B_CheatSheet carries no cause-strength claim contradicting the report. That claim was false. Both records stay exactly as published: the evidence of how the escape happened is the point, and editing them would destroy it.
